product_metadata.title: KXLife 2 Pack Adjustable Sticky Self Adhesive 3/8 Inch Sash Curtain Rod for Metal, Wood Doors, 11 to 17 Inch Multi-Use Sidelight Sash Cafe Rods for Door Panels, Windows, Bathroom(Nickel,Set of 2)
